evaluation_components.notes: Time Table, Will include reviewing and reproducing case studies from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google etc.
Well-defined evaluation criteria along with multiple deadlines throughout the semester. Also, includes paper presentation and review.
Each student or student team will have to present a set of research papers/topics and discuss in the classroom.

attendance_policy: Attendance in the lectures is highly encouraged. But there are no marks associated with attendance in the lectures.
makeup_policy: Make-up tests will be given only to genuine cases.
